notes: v573 — you can now set the 💧 floor FROM THE RADAR. Until now that control only existed on the 📋 report card, so every warning ended with ‘go to the card’ — and it was easy to think you'd changed the floor when you'd changed something else. The radar's ‘floor is wide open’ warning now carries two buttons: SET $250K and SET $1M. Tapping one saves the floor, throws away the micro-cap grades, and starts a fresh background grading immediately — the counts follow within seconds, and the label beside them will name the floor they were measured on. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5), then tap SET $250K on the radar.
